$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 side (A3), low, from the wearer's left: the shoot has no clean right profile. The engraved wordmark on the left temple comes off stroke by stroke, by frequency-selective reconstruction (rows streaked the tortoise), and nothing goes on (the GCD is on the right only). A round print on the far (right) temple's inner face, seen through the far lens, comes off too: the band, as seen on the print's right, carried on to the rim (rows rebuilt from both ends streaked); the blue tortoise along the band's bottom stays, and the print's lower arc over it takes the smoothest fill through its border (left on the blue, it showed as a pale mottled streak). The view is a low three-quarter from the left, and its alt text says so. lens_cleanup.keep: the curved band seen through the near lens, rim to rim, about 10 px wide, passed for dust and was filled out where it was narrow; only its wide parts were kept, a floating dash and a stub (third review).

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near (left) temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
round print on the right temple's inner face, seen through the far lens
the round print's lower arc, over the blue tortoise below the band (defocused: the smoothest fill through its border)
